args.body: Take the existing CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL mission under a valid lease. Reuse the completed reply rehearsal as the acceptance reference. Draft the fictional inquiry from the actual live offer capture before reading the internal input checklist, then record which required inputs a buyer could infer and which required clarification. Execute the relevant existing merchant controls on that inquiry. If the live instructions omit a required field, stage the smallest bilingual correction outside the public site and run the same exercise again. Save the actual outputs and before/after clarification count, read them back and close with a lesson. Keep CAD 60 provisional and preserve the separate item 4 decision. Use synthetic data only. No outreach, spending or deployment.

description: The catalogue reply rehearsal is complete. The next test is whether a buyer can provide everything needed for a useful reply using only the live offer instructions. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand and attribution remain unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The offline test can proceed now. A paid quote depends on approval of the exact terms, and order acceptance and deposit verification require separate administrative evidence. Any public wording change requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
